items.title: Northrop Grumman (NOC) Stock Could Trade At A 19% Discount On Raised Guidance
items.summary: Northrop Grumman stock is being priced by the market at a recent close of US$545.57, while both the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and earnings-based multiples point to the shares trading at a discount, even though the broader valuation checks only give it a mixed score rather than a clear bargain label. Over the past 5 years, Northrop Grumman has returned 61.0%, which shows the stock has already rewarded patient holders even before considering any valuation gap...

items.title: Northrop Grumman Corp's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: This upcoming cash dividend of $2.47 per share is payable on 2026-09-16, marking another milestone in the company's long history of rewarding shareholders.  As investors look forward to this payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.  Using the data from GuruFocus, let's delve into Northrop Grumman Corp's dividend performance and assess its sustainability for value-oriented investors seeking reliable income streams.

items.title: Russian strike kills 27 near Kyiv as Moscow militarizes schools
items.summary: Investing.com -- At least 27 people were killed in a Russian drone strike near Kyiv overnight, as Moscow continues to intensify its war effort and expand military training across Russian schools, Bloomberg reported Saturday.
